source.title: BZCC console command reference
source.method: In-game console with `console.log` file logging on: `ls`, then each namespace and nested scope typed bare; parsed from the session logs. Values are examples from the map loaded at the time; personal settings (options, gameprefs, inputbind, network, keybind, audio) keep names and types only.
source.limitations: Names come from the in-game listings; the executable's string table only cross-checks them. Bare commands with no namespace (such as `ls`) are listed only where observed. Explanations carry an evidence tier; an `inferred` tier is a reading of the name, not a verified behaviour.

blocks.text: Battlezone: Combat Commander has a built-in console whose variables and commands are grouped into namespaces. This reference lists every one the game reported, captured from the console itself (BZCC 2.0.206.10) and cross-checked against the executable, the shell configuration files and the map editor panels.

items.text: Typing a namespace or scope name on its own (`sky`, `network.session`) lists its members: `Cmd name` is a command, `name = value` is a variable, and `[sub]` is a nested scope you list the same way.
Typing a variable name prints its value; typing it followed by a value sets it (`sun.angle 12` moves the sun to noon). Commands may take arguments in the same way.
Statements end with `;`. `ls sky` and `help` are syntax errors ("Expecting ';'"); use the bare name instead.

`console.log` toggles file logging. While on, every console line is written to the session log (`Battlezone <date>.log` in `My Games\Battlezone Combat Commander`, which may sit under OneDrive) as `DIAG| console:NNN |time|tick|text`.

blocks.text: Each entry names where its explanation comes from. **Verified in-game**: checked in the running game or decoded from map files and confirmed by the console. **Engine text**: the game's own output format, editor panel label or GamePrefs.ini comment. **Usage context**: how the shell configuration files invoke it. **Inferred**: a reading of the name only; treat as a hypothesis. **Community knowledge**: documented by players, not re-verified here.

items.text: **World and atmosphere**: `sky` (atmosphere, fog, clouds), `sun` (light, time of day), `fog` (local, ground and water fog), `dome` (sky dome mesh and dome light), `stars` (starfield layer), `sprites` (sky billboards), `rain` (weather), `splat` (ground, water and windshield splats), `chrome` (environment reflection map), `terrain` (terrain material and detail), `bump` (bump mapping), `mesh` (mesh rendering), `vid` (video and render settings)

**Game and mission**: `game` (game session), `mission` (load, save, restart), `script` (mission script and cinematics), `ai` (AI debugging), `scrap` (scrap readouts), `control` (command panel, groups, satellite, teams), `status` (HUD readouts), `view` (camera views), `editor` (map editor)

**Settings and input**: `options` (player options), `gameprefs` (GamePrefs.ini overrides), `keybind` (key binding commands), `inputbind` (input bindings), `audio` (audio), `iface` (interface and console display), `shell` (menu shell)

Names come from the in-game listings; the executable's string table only cross-checks them. Bare commands with no namespace (such as `ls`) are listed only where observed. Explanations carry an evidence tier; an `inferred` tier is a reading of the name, not a verified behaviour.

blocks.text: The per-map atmosphere. Everything here is saved in the map's `.sky` file (BZCC's editor documentation: "the SKY file contains all the information regarding atmosphere, weather, fog and effects, sun angle and time of day, sky graphics, ambient color, and visibility distance"). The `[NormalView]` fog and `[Light]` keys in the older `.trn` are no longer what the game renders; only the terrain material keys there still apply (see `terrain`). Values below were read on Europa Night (`vsreuronig`); Remnant reads fog `120 110 80`, range `300 -> 600`, visibility `600`, ambient `55 90 120`.
Example values below were read on `vsreuronig`.
Writes the current sky settings to `<map>.sky` (`Saved <map>.sky`). Do not run this on a shipped map unless you mean to change it.
Reloads `<map>.sky` from disk (`Loaded <map>.sky`). Prints nothing visible in 2.0.206 when the file is already current.

sky.load bridges
sky.load chill
sky.load ctfpluto

Flips one `sky.flags` layer bit (the editor's Toggle Dome / Stars / Flat / Clouds / Sprites / Sun buttons write through it) and prints the six switches as `DOME=%d STARS=%d FLAT=%d CLOUDS=%d SPRITES=%d SUN=%d`.
Sky type selector written by the editor's Sky panel (`SkyType` in the legacy `.trn`); prints `sky type = %d`. Every VSR map uses the dome type.

Prints and sets the scene's ambient light, the flat fill every surface receives before the sun is added. Europa Night `10 15 20` (a near-black night fill), Remnant `55 90 120`. On the flat-lit lunar maps it is `255 255 255` with a black sun.

Prints and sets the distance-fog colour. In 2.0.206 this is the colour stored first in the map's `.sky` file (`SKY1` chunk offset 0x00); `fogcolorr/g/b/a` are its channels. Remnant prints `fogColor = 120 110 80 RGB`, Europa Night `20 25 30`. Everything beyond `fogend` fades to this colour.
Fog curve: `0` none, `1` exponential, `2` exponential-squared, `3` linear. Every VSR map checked reports `3`. The game says the value is saved by editing the `.trn`, not the `.sky`.
Density used by the exponential fog modes (`fogmode` 1 and 2). Unused under the linear mode every VSR map ships with.

Prints `fogRange = <start> -> <end>` and sets both ends at once. Distance fog is linear: nothing is fogged nearer than `fogstart`, everything is fully `fogcolor` at `fogend`. Remnant `300 -> 600` metres, Europa Night `150 -> 500`. Players can only shorten these (GamePrefs `VisibilityMult`, `MaxFogRange`), never extend them.

The editor's "Sky Color" in the Sky Texture group: the tint of the dome and of the flat cloud layer (`sky.texturename`), whose alpha (`sky.colora`) is that layer's opacity. Stored in the `.sky` as a BGRA byte colour (`SKY1` offset 0x74). Europa Night `40 55 60`, Remnant `180 170 130`. It is NOT a clear colour: where no sky layer draws the game shows `fogcolor` (Europa Night's dome-off sky reads the fully fogged value between its cloud wisps up to 30 degrees).
Sets both cloud scroll speeds (`uspeed vspeed`) in one command.
Red channel of the distance-fog colour (`sky.fogcolor`).
Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

Bit field of the sky layers the engine draws, one bit per editor toggle (`bzeditor_sky.cfg`), named the same way by the engine's own `sky.toggle` print-out (`DOME= STARS= FLAT= CLOUDS= SPRITES= SUN=`): `1` Dome, `2` Stars, `4` Flat (the `sky.texturename` cloud plane -- the legacy `.trn` `[Sky] SkyTexture / SkyHeight / SkyColor` section), `8` Clouds (the legacy `[Clouds] Count / TextureN / SizeN / HeightN` cloud billboards; `Count = 0` on every VSR map, so nothing is drawn), `16` Sprites, `32` Sun. Remnant `49` = dome + sprites + sun; Europa Night `54` = stars + flat + sprites + sun, so its template dome name is never drawn and the sky is the fog colour with stars, the full-moon sun and faint cloud wisps. The directional light and the sun (or moon) sprite. The sun travels a fixed east-to-west arc: `angle 6` is sunrise on the east horizon, `12` is directly overhead, `18` is sunset in the west, with `period` hours per full cycle, in real time. The `color` alpha scales the light's brightness. Verified live on Remnant.

Prints and sets the sun light's colour as `R G B A`. The alpha is the light's intensity: Remnant `255 230 150 200` (a warm sun at 0.78), Europa Night `255 255 255 125` (white moonlight at 0.49), Know Thyself alpha 500 (1.96). Lunar, Lunix and Moonshroud use `0 0 0` and light the scene with ambient alone.

entries.text: Battlezone: Combat Commander has a built-in console whose variables and commands are grouped into namespaces. This reference lists every one the game reported, captured from the console itself (BZCC 2.0.206.10) and cross-checked against the executable, the shell configuration files and the map editor panels.

entries.label: sky.save
entries.text: Writes the current sky settings to `<map>.sky` (`Saved <map>.sky`). Do not run this on a shipped map unless you mean to change it.

entries.label: sky.load
entries.text: Reloads `<map>.sky` from disk (`Loaded <map>.sky`). Prints nothing visible in 2.0.206 when the file is already current. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: sky.toggle
entries.text: Flips one `sky.flags` layer bit (the editor's Toggle Dome / Stars / Flat / Clouds / Sprites / Sun buttons write through it) and prints the six switches as `DOME=%d STARS=%d FLAT=%d CLOUDS=%d SPRITES=%d SUN=%d`.

entries.label: sky.type
entries.text: Sky type selector written by the editor's Sky panel (`SkyType` in the legacy `.trn`); prints `sky type = %d`. Every VSR map uses the dome type. Prints `sky type = %d`.

entries.label: sky.ambientColor
entries.text: Prints and sets the scene's ambient light, the flat fill every surface receives before the sun is added. Europa Night `10 15 20` (a near-black night fill), Remnant `55 90 120`. On the flat-lit lunar maps it is `255 255 255` with a black sun. Prints `sky.ambientColor = %.0f %.0f %.0f`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: sky.fogColor
entries.text: Prints and sets the distance-fog colour. In 2.0.206 this is the colour stored first in the map's `.sky` file (`SKY1` chunk offset 0x00); `fogcolorr/g/b/a` are its channels. Remnant prints `fogColor = 120 110 80 RGB`, Europa Night `20 25 30`. Everything beyond `fogend` fades to this colour. Prints `fogColor = %.0f %.0f %.0f RGB`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: sky.fogMode
entries.text: Fog curve: `0` none, `1` exponential, `2` exponential-squared, `3` linear. Every VSR map checked reports `3`. The game says the value is saved by editing the `.trn`, not the `.sky`. Prints `fogMode = %d (0=none, 1=exp, 2=exp2, 3=linear). Edit .trn file to save`.

entries.label: sky.fogExponentDensity
entries.text: Density used by the exponential fog modes (`fogmode` 1 and 2). Unused under the linear mode every VSR map ships with.

entries.label: sky.fogRange
entries.text: Prints `fogRange = <start> -> <end>` and sets both ends at once. Distance fog is linear: nothing is fogged nearer than `fogstart`, everything is fully `fogcolor` at `fogend`. Remnant `300 -> 600` metres, Europa Night `150 -> 500`. Players can only shorten these (GamePrefs `VisibilityMult`, `MaxFogRange`), never extend them. Prints `fogRange = %5.0f -> %5.0f`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor.cfg.

entries.label: sky.color
entries.text: The editor's "Sky Color" in the Sky Texture group: the tint of the dome and of the flat cloud layer (`sky.texturename`), whose alpha (`sky.colora`) is that layer's opacity. Stored in the `.sky` as a BGRA byte colour (`SKY1` offset 0x74). Europa Night `40 55 60`, Remnant `180 170 130`. It is NOT a clear colour: where no sky layer draws the game shows `fogcolor` (Europa Night's dome-off sky reads the fully fogged value between its cloud wisps up to 30 degrees). Prints `sky color = %d %d %d %d RGBA`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: sky.uvspeed
entries.text: Sets both cloud scroll speeds (`uspeed vspeed`) in one command. Prints `uv speed = %.3f %.3f`; `sky uv speed = %f %f`.

entries.label: sky.fogcolorr
entries.text: Red channel of the distance-fog colour (`sky.fogcolor`). Editor fog panel control "Red". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: sky.flags
entries.text: Bit field of the sky layers the engine draws, one bit per editor toggle (`bzeditor_sky.cfg`), named the same way by the engine's own `sky.toggle` print-out (`DOME= STARS= FLAT= CLOUDS= SPRITES= SUN=`): `1` Dome, `2` Stars, `4` Flat (the `sky.texturename` cloud plane -- the legacy `.trn` `[Sky] SkyTexture / SkyHeight / SkyColor` section), `8` Clouds (the legacy `[Clouds] Count / TextureN / SizeN / HeightN` cloud billboards; `Count = 0` on every VSR map, so nothing is drawn), `16` Sprites, `32` Sun. Remnant `49` = dome + sprites + sun; Europa Night `54` = stars + flat + sprites + sun, so its template dome name is never drawn and the sky is the fog colour with stars, the full-moon sun and faint cloud wisps. Bit `64` appears on six maps and has no toggle. Editor sky panel control "Toggle Dome / Toggle Stars / Toggle Flat / Toggle Clouds". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg, editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg, editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg, editor/bzeditor_sun.cfg.

entries.label: sky.visibilityrange
entries.text: Far clip distance in metres: nothing beyond it is drawn at all. 600 on Remnant and Europa Night; the corpus spans 320 to 1000. Because `fogend` is at or below this, the cut is hidden inside fully fogged pixels. Editor fog panel control "Visibility Range". Prints `visibilityRange = %5.0f`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor.cfg, editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

Editor fog panel control "Fog Break". Prints `fog break = %f`; `fogBreak = at %f between start and end`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: sun.color
entries.text: Prints and sets the sun light's colour as `R G B A`. The alpha is the light's intensity: Remnant `255 230 150 200` (a warm sun at 0.78), Europa Night `255 255 255 125` (white moonlight at 0.49), Know Thyself alpha 500 (1.96). Lunar, Lunix and Moonshroud use `0 0 0` and light the scene with ambient alone. Prints `sun color = %.0f %.0f %.0f %.0f`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sun.cfg.

entries.label: sun.ambientcolor
entries.text: Alias of `sky.ambientcolor` registered under the sun scope.

entries.label: sun.period
entries.text: Length of a full day-night cycle in **real-time hours** (the game prints `sun period = %f realtime hours`). `24` on most maps, so the sun drifts about 15 degrees per hour of play; Bolt uses `1` (a full cycle every hour) and Marden Warfare `2400` (static). Editor sun panel control "Period (Hours)". Prints `sun period = %f realtime hours`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sun.cfg.

entries.label: sun.angle
entries.text: Position of the sun along its arc, in the same hour units as `period`. `6` puts it on the east horizon, `12` directly overhead, `18` on the west horizon (verified live on Remnant). Authored values: Remnant `16.0`, Europa Night `15.5`. The capture caught `18.0` because the probe left it there; the stored value is `15.5`. Editor sun panel control "Angle". Prints `sun angle = %f`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sun.cfg.

Unlike `sprites.size`, which is metres at `sprites.distance`. Editor sun panel control "Size". Prints `sun size = %f degrees`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sun.cfg.

entries.text: Half-extents of the selected volume (`x y z`); the template volumes are 100 x 30 x 100 metres.

entries.label: fog.userPosition
entries.text: Moves the selected volume to the player's position (editor convenience).

entries.label: fog.cameraPosition
entries.text: Moves the selected volume to the camera position (the editor's "Snap to Camera Position" button). Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.localcolor
entries.text: Colour of the selected local fog volume (`R G B`); `-1 -1 -1` means use the global fog colour. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.height
entries.text: Sets the height (ground) fog band in one command; see `heightstart`, `heightend`, `heightdensity`.

entries.label: fog.heightminDist
entries.text: Camera distance at which ground fog starts to apply. Editor fog panel control "Min Dist". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.toggle
entries.text: Shows or hides the local fog volumes (the editor's "Show/Hide Local Fog" button). Editor fog panel control "Show/Hide Local Fog". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.select
entries.text: Index of the local fog volume (0-15) that `position`, `radius`, `density` and `localcolor` edit. Editor fog panel control "Fog Select". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.localcolorr
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Red". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.density
entries.text: Density of the selected local fog volume; `-1` marks an unused slot in the `.sky` file. Editor fog panel control "Density". Prints `density= %f`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.positionx
entries.text: X of the selected local fog volume's centre. Editor fog panel control "Position". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.positiony
entries.text: Y (height) of the selected local fog volume's centre. Editor fog panel control "Position". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.positionz
entries.text: Z of the selected local fog volume's centre. Editor fog panel control "Position". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.radiusx
entries.text: X half-extent of the selected local fog volume. Editor fog panel control "Width". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.radiusy
entries.text: Y half-extent (height) of the selected local fog volume. Editor fog panel control "Height". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.radiusz
entries.text: Z half-extent of the selected local fog volume. Editor fog panel control "Depth". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.localcolorg
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.localcolorb
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.uspeed
entries.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along U. Editor fog panel control "UV Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.vspeed
entries.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along V. Editor fog panel control "UV Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.heightcurve
entries.text: Shape of the density falloff across the ground fog band (editor "Curve" slider). Editor fog panel control "Curve". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.wspeed
entries.text: Scroll speed of the local-fog volume texture along W (the 3D fog texture's third axis). Editor fog panel control "UV Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.heightstart
entries.text: World height where the ground fog band begins. 0 with `heightdensity` 0 means no ground fog (Remnant, Europa Night); Twin Peaks and DuneNight use -50 to 200. Editor fog panel control "Height Start". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.heightend
entries.text: World height where the ground fog band ends. Editor fog panel control "Height End". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.heightdensity
entries.text: Density of the ground fog band; `0` or `-1` disables it. Editor fog panel control "Density". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.heightmaxDist
entries.text: Camera distance at which ground fog reaches full density (150 on the maps checked). Editor fog panel control "Max Dist". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.color
entries.text: Sets the underwater fog colours; see the `topcolor*` and `bottomcolor*` channels. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.visibility
entries.text: Sets the underwater visibility distance. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.depth
entries.text: Visibility depth of the underwater fog. Editor fog panel control "Fog Depth". Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.enable
entries.text: Turns underwater fog on (`1`) or off (`0`); the game prints `underwater fog is %d`. Editor fog panel control "Toggle Water Fog". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.top
entries.text: Depth below the surface where the top fog colour applies (`top fog end = %fm`). Editor fog panel control "Fog End". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.topcolorb
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.bottom
entries.text: Depth where the bottom fog colour is reached (`bottom fog end = %fm`). Editor fog panel control "Fog Start". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.break
entries.text: Fraction between the top and bottom depths where the two colours cross over. Editor fog panel control "Fog Break". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.topcolorr
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Red". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.topcolorg
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.bottomcolorr
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Red". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.bottomcolorg
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: fog.water.bottomcolorb
entries.text: Editor fog panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_fog.cfg.

entries.label: dome.ambient
entries.text: Colour the dome mesh is lit with (`R G B`), independent of the scene lights; `100 60 20` in the stock dunes template. Prints `ambient = %d %d %d RGB`; `ambient: RGB=%d %d %d`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.uv
entries.text: Sets the dome texture offset (`u v`).

entries.label: dome.uvspeed
entries.text: Sets the dome texture scroll speed (`uspeed vspeed`). Prints `uv speed = %.3f %.3f`.

entries.label: dome.ambientr
entries.text: Red channel of the dome's lighting colour. Editor sky panel control "Alpha". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.ambientg
entries.text: Green channel of the dome's lighting colour. Editor sky panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.uspeed
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "U Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.ambientb
entries.text: Blue channel of the dome's lighting colour. Editor sky panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.name
entries.text: Dome mesh file (`miredome.fbx` on 46 VSR maps, `dunedome` 25, `plutodome` 15, `banedome` 14, `marsdome` 10, `rendsky.xsi` 8, `darkdome` 7, a few others), baked by the game to `.msh`. It is only drawn when `sky.flags` has the Dome bit (1): Europa Night names `miredome.fbx` but has the bit off, so its sky is stars and faint cloud wisps over the fog colour. Editor sky panel control "Dome Name". Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.u
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "Distance". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.v
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "Distance". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.vspeed
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "V Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.radius
entries.text: Dome radius in metres (300 on Europa Night, 200 on Remnant). Stored in the `.sky` `DOME` chunk. Editor sky panel control "Radius". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.height
entries.text: Vertical offset of the dome mesh in metres (editor "Dome Height"); 0 on Europa Night and Remnant, 20-100 on most other VSR maps, -10 on the lunar maps. Editor sky panel control "Dome Height". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.type
entries.text: Dome type selector: the editor's "Dome" (0, 74 VSR maps) or "Planet" (1, 64 maps; Remnant and Europa Night); four maps store 2. No visible difference between 0 and 1 has been established. Editor sky panel control "Dome / Planet". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.azim
entries.text: Rotation of the dome mesh about the vertical axis, in degrees. Editor sky panel control "Planet Azim". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.distance
entries.text: Draw distance of the dome (editor "Distance"); equals the radius on the maps checked. Editor sky panel control "Distance". Prints `distance = %f`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.description
entries.text: Prints the dome light's settings. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.position
entries.text: Sets the dome light's direction as azimuth and elevation (the editor's Azim / Elev sliders).

entries.label: dome.light.colorr
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.select
entries.text: Index of the dome light being edited. Editor sky panel control "Light Select". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.range
entries.text: Range of the dome light. Editor sky panel control "Light Range". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.attenuation
entries.text: Attenuation of the dome light. Editor sky panel control "Attenuation". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.azim
entries.text: Azimuth of the dome light in degrees (90 in the stock template). Editor sky panel control "Azim". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.elev
entries.text: Elevation of the dome light in degrees (35 in the stock template). Editor sky panel control "Elev". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.colorb
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.dist
entries.text: Distance of the dome light from the camera. Editor sky panel control "Light Distance". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: dome.light.colorg
entries.text: Editor sky panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sky.cfg.

entries.label: stars.speed
entries.text: Sets the starfield drift (`azimspeed elevspeed`).

entries.label: stars.color
entries.text: Sets the star tint (`R G B A`); white everywhere, alpha 255 on most maps (100 on a few).

entries.label: stars.count
entries.text: Number of star sprites drawn when `sky.flags` has the Stars bit (2); 128 on Europa Night and most maps, 64 or 84 on others. Positions are not stored in the `.sky`; the engine scatters them at load. Editor stars panel control "Stars Count". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.height
entries.text: Vertical offset of the starfield layer in metres (0 on most maps, 10-100 on 21). Editor stars panel control "Height". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.distance
entries.text: Distance at which the stars are drawn, in metres (200 on Europa Night, 100 in the template). Editor stars panel control "Distance". Prints `distance = %f`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.size
entries.text: Size of each star sprite in metres at `stars.distance` (0.2 on Europa Night, 1.0 in the stock template): well under a pixel, so the stars draw as the smallest points the renderer allows. Editor stars panel control "Size". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.texture
entries.text: Star sprite texture (`lightflare.tga` on 141 of 142 VSR maps, `plasma.dds` on one). Editor stars panel control "Star Texture". Prints `texture = %s`; `texture=%s`. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.modulate
entries.text: Blend mode of the star sprites: `1` is the editor's "Add", `0` "Blend" (Europa Night 1). Editor stars panel control "Modulation / Blend". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.colorb
entries.text: Editor stars panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.azimspeed
entries.text: Starfield rotation speed about the vertical axis (0 on all but four maps, which store 1000). Editor stars panel control "Azim Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.elevspeed
entries.text: Starfield drift speed in elevation (0 on all but four maps). Editor stars panel control "Elev Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.colorr
entries.text: Editor stars panel control "Elev Speed". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.colorg
entries.text: Editor stars panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: stars.colora
entries.text: Editor stars panel control "Alpha". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_stars.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.color
entries.text: Sets the selected sprite's tint (`R G B A`). Remnant's moon is `255 220 180 255`; the `.sky` stores the bytes as B,G,R,A. Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.colorr
entries.text: Editor sprites panel control "Red". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.select
entries.text: Index of the sky sprite being edited; the other `sprites.*` variables read and write that slot. Editor sprites panel control "Sprite Select". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.textureName
entries.text: Texture of the selected sprite (`dunemoon.tga`, `psnebu01.tga`, `godlight1.tga`, `lightflare.tga`). Editor sprites panel control "Sprite Texture". Shell config: invoked in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.modulate
entries.text: Blend mode of the selected sprite: `1` is the editor's "Add" -- additive, so a moon texture's black body adds nothing and only the lit crescent shows (Remnant's crescent adds about `+100 +85 +80` to the dome in the game, well under a full additive draw); `0` "Blend" -- an alpha disc (Earth on the lunar maps). Editor sprites panel control "Modulation / Blend". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.colorg
entries.text: Editor sprites panel control "Green". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.colorb
entries.text: Editor sprites panel control "Blue". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.colora
entries.text: Alpha of the selected sprite's tint (its opacity): 255 on both Remnant moons, 100 on the template's hidden godlight slot. Editor sprites panel control "Alpha". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.distance
entries.text: Distance of the sprite shell in metres (100 on every VSR map; the `.sky` SPRT header). A sprite's `size` is metres at this distance. Editor sprites panel control "Distance". Prints `distance = %f`. Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.size
entries.text: Size of the selected sprite in metres at `sprites.distance` (100 on every VSR map), so the quad spans `2 atan(size / 200)`: Remnant's large crescent moon (40) covers 22.6 degrees, its small companion (10) 5.7. `0` hides the slot; the stock template carries 44 slots, most of them 0. Editor sprites panel control "Size". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.azim
entries.text: Compass direction of the selected sprite in degrees; `0` is north (the big moon on Remnant sits dead ahead when facing north), positive clockwise. Editor sprites panel control "Azim". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.elev
entries.text: Elevation of the selected sprite above the horizon in degrees. Editor sprites panel control "Elev". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.roll
entries.text: Roll of the selected sprite about its view axis in degrees. Editor sprites panel control "Roll". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_init.cfg, editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: sprites.height
entries.text: Vertical offset of the sprite shell in metres (0 on every VSR map; the `.sky` SPRT header). Editor sprites panel control "Height". Shell config: bound to a control in editor/bzeditor_sprites.cfg.

entries.label: gameprefs.MaxVisibility
entries.text: GamePrefs.ini: Values to allow the user to pull in (but never extend) the visibility, fog ranges on maps. If the values below are under the values set by a map, they are used. If they are above, they are ignored. These settings don't affect the Editor build, where you'd want higher draw distances. Note: also adjustable with "gameprefs.MaxVisibility", and similar Default `99999.0`.

entries.label: gameprefs.MaxFogRange
entries.text: GamePrefs.ini: Values to allow the user to pull in (but never extend) the visibility, fog ranges on maps. If the values below are under the values set by a map, they are used. If they are above, they are ignored. These settings don't affect the Editor build, where you'd want higher draw distances. Note: also adjustable with "gameprefs.MaxVisibility", and similar Default `99999.0`.

entries.label: gameprefs.MinFogRange
entries.text: GamePrefs.ini: Values to allow the user to pull in (but never extend) the visibility, fog ranges on maps. If the values below are under the values set by a map, they are used. If they are above, they are ignored. These settings don't affect the Editor build, where you'd want higher draw distances. Note: also adjustable with "gameprefs.MaxVisibility", and similar Default `99999.0`.

entries.label: gameprefs.VisibilityMult
entries.text: GamePrefs.ini: Multiplier applied to default visibility, fog ranges on maps. This value must be between 0.1 (can see only 10% as far as normal) and 1.0 (normal).  This multiplier is applied before the maxes are applies above, and may be more useful in trimming view distances. Default `1.0`.

entries.label: gameprefs.Play_CockpitRadarCaretMode
entries.text: GamePrefs.ini: Adjusts the out of range "caret" rendering for non-important items on the Cockpit Radar. 0 = Don't display carets for anything outside of range (default behavior) 1 = Displays carets for enemies and CLASS_DEPOSIT (pools) visible on radar. 2 = Displays carets for everything visible on radar. This doesn't change what is visible, it only adds carets for items that are visible to the edge of the Cockpit Radar. BZ1 effectively used 2. Default `0`.

entries.text: Toggles console file logging; prints `Console file logging is now ON` / `OFF`. While on, every console line is appended to the session log as `DIAG| console:NNN |time|tick|text`. In 2.0.206 the log lives in `My Games\Battlezone Combat Commander\Battlezone <date>.log`.

entries.label: sys.info
entries.text: Prints system information (CPU, memory, adapter).

entries.label: sys.uptime
entries.text: Prints how long the game has been running.

entries.label: sys.ver
entries.text: Prints the game version (2.0.206.10 in this capture).

entries.label: sys.runcode
entries.text: Prints or switches the current run code (shell, mission, editor). Shell config: invoked in shell/bzshell.cfg, shell/bzshell_login.cfg, shell/bzshellmp.cfg.

entries.label: debug.assetcrcs
entries.text: Prints asset checksums (the values compared between players in multiplayer).

entries.label: debug.collisions
entries.text: Draws collision shapes; GamePrefs `MaxCollisionDrawDistance` limits how far from the camera they are drawn.

entries.label: debug.playerinfo
entries.text: Shows a player information overlay.

entries.label: debug.bump
entries.text: Bump-mapping debug view.

entries.label: debug.boundingbox
entries.text: Draws object bounding boxes.

entries.label: iam.gsutty
entries.text: Command `gsutty` in the `iam` scope; takes arguments in the usual `name value` form.
